title: Fusion Reactor Simulator: reactor configuration
description: The configuration of one simulated shot: the argument of `new Simulation(cfg)`. `method` selects the family; every property of a family is listed and unknown properties are rejected. Generated from src/physics/config/schema.ts (npm run schema); do not edit.

kappa.description: Elongation of the 95 % flux surface (of the LCFS if profiles.lcfsKappa is not given).

geometry.description: Plasma shape (D-shaped Miller-type cross section). Rule minor-radius-below-major-radius: geometry.a must be smaller than geometry.R (aspect ratio R/a above 1).

x-rules.description: geometry.a must be smaller than geometry.R (aspect ratio R/a above 1).

gridPacking.description: Edge packing of the radial cells (tanh step in the cell density): the cells at the pedestal and the separatrix are (1 + gridPacking) times narrower than the core cells, for the same nRho. 0 is the uniform grid of v3.

rtol.description: Relative tolerance of the error control of the transport time step (TR-BDF2). The model replaces a value outside its domain by the default at run time.

atol.description: Absolute tolerance of the error control of the transport time step, as a fraction of the profile maximum (0: a purely relative tolerance).

dtMax.description: Longest transport time step. Unit: s.

nonlinearSolver.description: Solver of the nonlinear system of a transport stage. 'auto': Newton-Raphson for a predictive transport model ('cgm'), the Pereverzev-Corrigan Picard iteration for the closures that ask for it ('bgb', 'ifspppl': Newton costs more than it buys there), Picard iteration with Anderson mixing for 'scaling'; 'picard', 'newton' (with the Pereverzev-Corrigan Picard iteration as its fallback) and 'pc' (that stabilised Picard iteration alone) force one.

IpWaveform.description: Plasma-current programme I_p(t): the boundary condition of the current diffusion as points [t (s), I_p (MA)] in increasing time, linearly interpolated and held constant beyond the first and last point. Ip_MA is what the initial equilibrium is solved for and should equal the programme at t = 0. Absent: I_p constant (and a live control). Points [s, MA], the first number strictly increasing.

eqUpdateInterval.description: Upper limit of the interval between equilibrium updates. Unit: s.

lcfsKappa.description: Elongation of the last closed flux surface; the elongation of `geometry` (a 95 % value) if absent.

lcfsDelta.description: Triangularity of the last closed flux surface; the triangularity of `geometry` if absent.

kappa.description: Elongation of the 95 % surface that lcfsKappa belongs to.

delta.description: Triangularity of the 95 % surface that lcfsDelta belongs to.

lcfsRef95.description: The 95 % surface shape (kappa95, delta95) that lcfsKappa and lcfsDelta belong to. The 0D volume, surface and cross-section then follow an edited `geometry.kappa` or `geometry.delta` in the ratio kappa/kappa95 and delta/delta95 (the ITER and DEMO presets); without it the LCFS values are absolute.

transportModel.description: 'scaling': transport constrained by the tau_E scaling law (validated global dynamics); 'cgm': critical-gradient model (predictive, uncalibrated); 'bgb': mixed Bohm/gyro-Bohm model of Erba et al. (predictive, JET-validated coefficients; the Bohm term is non-local in the edge temperature); 'ifspppl': IFS-PPPL ITG critical gradient and stiffness of Kotschenreuther et al. 1995 (predictive). Every model but 'scaling' is predictive: tau_E and H98 emerge (the diagnostics H98y2 and HITPA20).

chiShape.description: Shape of chi, proportional to 1 + chiShape rho^2.

stiffness.description: Profile stiffness: chi is multiplied by 1 + stiffness max(0, (R/L_T)/critGrad - 1).

etbFactor.description: Edge transport barrier: chi_ETB / chi_turb at the pedestal.

alphaCritFactor.description: ELM trigger threshold as a multiple of the critical ballooning alpha.

elmFraction.description: ELM crash depth, Delta W / W_ped.

sawtoothShear.description: Shear s1 at q = 1 that triggers a sawtooth crash.

nbiRtan.description: NBI tangency radius over the major radius.

Tsep_keV.description: Fixed separatrix temperature; the two-point model if absent. Unit: keV.

nsepFrac.description: Separatrix density over the volume-averaged electron density.

edgeModel.description: Separatrix temperature of the 1.5D boundary. 'legacy': conduction-limited two-point T_sep (outboard share 0.6, clamped to 0.03-0.5 keV); 'twoPoint': T_sep of the edge model (Eich lambda_q, divertor spreading, outer-leg power share), guard band 5 eV - 2 keV. The edge diagnostics use the edge model either way.

neoclassicalModel.description: Coefficients of the bootstrap current and of the neoclassical conductivity. 'sauter': Sauter, Angioni and Lin-Liu (1999, with the 2002 correction); 'redl': Redl et al. (2021), the same structure refitted to the numerical code NEO (less bootstrap current in the collisional edge and with impurities).

profileSettings.description: 1.5D profile-model settings (only used with fidelity "1.5D"); every property overrides the model default.

B0.description: Toroidal field on axis. Unit: T.

Ip_MA.description: Plasma current (0 for a stellarator: bootstrap current neglected). Unit: MA.

fuel.description: Fuel cycle: D-T, D-D, D-3He or p-11B.

fuelFracA.description: Fraction of the first species (D-T: n_D / (n_D + n_T)).

n_target.description: Target volume-averaged electron density. Unit: m^-3.

E_NBI_keV.description: Neutral-beam energy per atom (must be positive even with P_NBI_MW = 0). Unit: keV.

f_ICRH_ion.description: Fraction of the ICRH power absorbed by the ions.

P_ECRH_MW.description: Electron-cyclotron heating power (electrons only). Unit: MW.

autoOff.description: Switch the heating off once Q reaches 5 (ignition test).

pelletDepth.description: Pellet penetration depth (fraction of the minor radius).

W_source_frac.description: Additional tungsten source (divertor erosion feeding core accumulation).

seedSpecies.description: Divertor seeding impurity (Ar, Ne or N in a real machine).

seedConcentration.description: Divertor seeding concentration n_seed / n_e (constant, no dynamics).

H98.description: H-mode confinement factor relative to the IPB98(y,2) scaling.

H89.description: L-mode confinement factor relative to the ITER89-P scaling.

scaling.description: Confinement scaling law of the H-mode: 'IPB98y2' (default), 'ITPA20' or 'ITPA20-IL' (Verdoolaege et al. 2021, areal elongation and average LCFS triangularity), 'ST_Valovic' (spherical tokamak); H98 multiplies the selected scaling.

iota23.description: Rotational transform at two thirds of the radius.

f_ren.description: Deprecated: ISS04 renormalisation, tau_E = f_ren H98 tau_ISS04 when H_ISS04 is not given.

H_ISS04.description: Confinement multiplier relative to ISS04: tau_E = H_ISS04 tau_ISS04 (then f_ren and H98 are not used).

greenwald_limit.description: Density limit as a fraction of the Greenwald density.

q95_limit.description: Lower limit of q95 (disruption below it).

W_conc_limit.description: Tungsten concentration limit (radiative collapse above it).

limits.description: Operational limits that end the shot.

tau_p_over_tau_E.description: Particle confinement time over the energy confinement time.

tau_He_over_tau_E.description: Helium-ash confinement time over the energy confinement time.

tech.description: Magnet technology (sets the maximum field at the coil).

gap_m.description: Plasma-to-coil gap (blanket and vacuum vessel). Unit: m.

coverage.description: Fraction of the wall covered by breeding blanket.

f_rad_div.description: Fraction of the power radiated in the divertor.

flux_expansion.description: Poloidal flux expansion at the target.

outerShare.description: Share of P_sep carried by the outer target leg (default 2/3).

spreadingRatio.description: Divertor spreading S / lambda_q (default 1.22, i.e. lambda_int = 3 lambda_q).

S_mm.description: Absolute divertor spreading S; overrides spreadingRatio. Unit: mm.

lambdaQ_mm.description: Midplane heat-flux width; overrides the Eich regression #14. Unit: mm.

divertorLengthFraction.description: Length of the divertor leg over the connection length pi q95 R (default 0.3).

kappa0e.description: Parallel electron conductivity (default 2000). Unit: W m^-1 eV^-7/2.

lossFit.description: Momentum and power loss fit against the target temperature (default 'stangeby1').

radiation.description: 'prescribed' (default): the divertor radiates divertor.f_rad_div of the power; 'lengyel': the seed impurity radiates (Lengyel model).

seedEnrichment.description: Seed concentration of the SOL relative to impurity.seedConcentration (default 1).

detachTt_eV.description: Target electron temperature that defines the onset of detachment in the c_z requirement (default 5). Unit: eV.

strikeRadiusFraction.description: Strike-point radius offset from R as a fraction of a (default 0.3).

edge.description: Edge (SOL and divertor) model options; every property is optional and a missing one takes its default (src/physics/edge/params.ts).

capital_MUSD_override.description: Capital cost overriding the built-in estimate. Unit: MUSD.

t_end.description: Duration of the shot. Unit: s.

seed.description: Seed of the deterministic random generator (ELM, sawtooth and jitter sequences); an unsigned 32-bit integer.

fidelity.description: '0D': global power balance; '1.5D': radial profile transport with a Grad-Shafranov equilibrium (tokamak and spherical tokamak only, ignored for a stellarator).

pulseLength_s.description: Design length of the plasma pulse of the plant (current ramp-up + flat top + ramp-down): the time over which the pulsed-field energy is spread in the cryoplant load. A property of the machine, not of the simulated shot (default 1055 s, the PROCESS default plasma pulse). Unit: s.

nCoils.description: Number of TF coils (default 18; 24 for copper coils; 50 for a stellarator).

noseFraction.description: Share of the inboard-leg thickness that is solid steel case nose (default by technology).

structureFraction.description: Load-bearing area fraction of the winding-pack region: steel jacket, plates, side walls (default by technology).

turnCurrent_A.description: Operating current per turn (sets the current-lead heat load; default by technology). Unit: A.

verticalInboardFraction.description: Share of the vertical tension of the coil carried by the inboard leg (0.5 for a D-shaped coil).

tf.description: TF coil (winding pack and case) inputs.

currentDensity_MAm2.description: Smeared current density of the CS winding at the peak field; sets the CS thickness B / (mu0 J) (default by technology, 13.6 for Nb3Sn). Unit: MA m^-2.

B_max_T.description: Peak field of the CS conductor (default: the technology limit). Unit: T.

swingFraction.description: Share of the +B to -B field swing of the solenoid that is used (default 1).

pfFlux_Vs.description: Flux supplied by the poloidal-field coils (default 0). Unit: V s.

li.description: Internal inductance l_i(3) of the plasma for the inductive flux (default 0.85, or the 1.5D value).

outerRadius_m.description: Outer radius of the solenoid (default: the TF inner radius minus the gap between the solenoid and the TF nose). Unit: m.

thickness_m.description: Radial thickness of the solenoid winding; sets the current density B_max / (mu0 t) and takes precedence over currentDensity_MAm2. Unit: m.

height_m.description: Height of the solenoid stack (default: the height of the straight TF leg; only the stored energy and the mass depend on it). Unit: m.

ejima.description: Ejima coefficient C_E of the resistive flux of the current ramp-up, C_E mu0 R I_p (default 0.4: the middle of the experiments and the PROCESS value; 0.45 is the ITER design value).

cs.description: Central-solenoid flux budget. Giving this block turns the flux check on: a warning if the solenoid cannot supply the pulse.

inboardDepth_m.description: Inboard breeding-blanket depth (default: 56 % of the space behind the first wall). Unit: m.

breederFraction.description: HCPB breeder fraction Li4SiO4 / (Li4SiO4 + Be12Ti) (default: the tritium-optimal one).

blanket.description: Radial build and TBR options of the blanket.

systems.description: Systems-lite engineering models (TF coil stress, CS flux budget, cryoplant, radial build, TBR); only the shot report reads them, the plasma models never do. Every property is optional.

magneticConfig.description: Magnetic confinement: tokamak, spherical tokamak, stellarator. Rule tokamak-needs-plasma-current: Ip_MA must be above 0 unless the method is stellarator.

x-rules.description: Ip_MA must be above 0 unless the method is stellarator.

E_laser_MJ.description: Laser energy on target. Unit: MJ.

hohlraumEff.description: Indirect drive: laser to X-ray to capsule coupling.

fuel.description: Fuel cycle: D-T, D-D, D-3He or p-11B.

seed.description: Seed of the deterministic random generator (ELM, sawtooth and jitter sequences); an unsigned 32-bit integer.

icfConfig.description: Laser inertial confinement fusion, direct or indirect drive.

jitter_us.description: Piston or liner synchronisation error. Unit: us.

preheat_kJ.description: MagLIF laser preheat energy. Unit: kJ.

current_MA.description: Z-pinch or MagLIF driver current. Unit: MA.

fuel.description: Fuel cycle: D-T, D-D, D-3He or p-11B.

seed.description: Seed of the deterministic random generator (ELM, sawtooth and jitter sequences); an unsigned 32-bit integer.

mtfConfig.description: Magnetised target fusion, Z-pinch and MagLIF.

E_NBI_keV.description: Neutral-beam energy per atom. Unit: keV.

seed.description: Seed of the deterministic random generator (ELM, sawtooth and jitter sequences); an unsigned 32-bit integer.

fuel.description: Fuel cycle: D-T, D-D, D-3He or p-11B.

mirrorRatio.description: Mirror ratio R_m (loss-cone angle sin^2 = 1/R_m); must exceed 1.

seed.description: Seed of the deterministic random generator (ELM, sawtooth and jitter sequences); an unsigned 32-bit integer.

fuel.description: Fuel cycle: D-T, D-D, D-3He or p-11B.

plugPotential.description: Tandem end-plug potential e phi_c / T_i (default 1).

muonCost_GeV.description: Energy cost per muon. Unit: GeV.

density_LHD.description: Target density in units of the liquid-hydrogen density.

seed.description: Seed of the deterministic random generator (ELM, sawtooth and jitter sequences); an unsigned 32-bit integer.
